required_inputs: Frozen public PWR/SB-LOCA manifest and trajectory split.
One matched temporal-regression baseline and one bounded candidate configuration.
P-NEML-F01-D1-MANIFEST: manifest, labels, trajectory IDs, counts, units, sampling rate, and horizon available for read-only preflight.
P-NEML-F01-D1-SPLIT: trajectory- and scenario-level partition identities available for independence checking.
P-NEML-F01-D1-DOMAIN: every retained record is a labeled PWR SB-LOCA transient with declared break-extent unit, sampling rate, and horizon.
P-NEML-F01-D1-PHYSICS: required unit-labelled physics-derived residual or conservation feature columns available.
incompatible_conditions: Invalid provenance, ambiguous labels or units, missing sampling or horizon definitions, or unresolved required preconditions.
Non-independent entity, trajectory, scenario, configuration, or time partitions, or unresolved leakage.
Missing physics features, unsupported target-domain scope, or unavailable held-out evaluation strata.
Operational deployment, plant-data use, control or protection use, or unavailable qualified specialist safety review.

assumptions: The observational unit is a labeled PWR SB-LOCA trajectory/window; sampling, labels, missingness, dependence, stationarity, and target population are documented before any fit.
Entity, scenario, configuration, operating-mode, and time identities define independent partitions; exchangeability is assumed only within the declared training population.

Physics-derived residual or conservation features retain declared units and are identified as exact, approximate, learned, or unchecked constraints; learned outputs do not replace deterministic protections.

On a frozen leakage-free public SB-LOCA split, the physics-constrained uncertainty-aware candidate improves break-extent prediction while meeting the UQ and data criteria; this remains an unexecuted hypothesis.
Generalization across reactor designs, simulator configurations, scenarios, sensors, sites, time periods, or plant domains is a hypothesis until tested; target-domain transfer remains a hypothesis.
baselines: Matched temporal regression on the identical frozen split and resource ceiling.
controls: Use the identical frozen split, temporal backbone, seed, horizon, and inherited resource ceiling for the baseline and candidate.
procedure_outline: Use the route inputs: frozen public PWR/SB-LOCA manifest and trajectory split; one matched baseline and one bounded candidate configuration.
Read the manifest, labels, sampling rate, horizon, and partition identities before any fit; stop on a failed precondition.
Only after every preflight passes, fit one matched baseline and one bounded candidate within the inherited ceilings; this outline does not execute the route.
Score every bound metric once and record a closed Go, Stop, or Pivot disposition without deployment or safety claims.
Trace C-NEML-F01-D1-PRED exactly to M-NEML-F01-D1-MAE and P-NEML-F01-D1-MANIFEST, P-NEML-F01-D1-SPLIT, P-NEML-F01-D1-DOMAIN, P-NEML-F01-D1-PHYSICS; coverage is Go, Stop, and Pivot.
Trace C-NEML-F01-D1-UQ exactly to M-NEML-F01-D1-ECE and P-NEML-F01-D1-MANIFEST, P-NEML-F01-D1-SPLIT, P-NEML-F01-D1-DOMAIN, P-NEML-F01-D1-PHYSICS; coverage is Go, Stop, and Pivot.
Trace C-NEML-F01-D1-DATA exactly to M-NEML-F01-D1-N and P-NEML-F01-D1-MANIFEST, P-NEML-F01-D1-SPLIT, P-NEML-F01-D1-DOMAIN, P-NEML-F01-D1-PHYSICS; coverage is Go, Stop, and Pivot.
Go coverage derived from the route is M-NEML-F01-D1-MAE >= 5.0 percent, M-NEML-F01-D1-ECE <= 0.08 fraction, and M-NEML-F01-D1-N >= 30 count.
Record raw metric values and compare them mechanically with the route-bound Go, Stop, and Pivot criteria; no empirical completion or safety claim is authorized.
uncertainty_handling: Report M-NEML-F01-D1-ECE on the untouched held-out split and compare behavior across declared target-domain strata.
Separate sampling, label, measurement, model, parameter, optimization, and distribution-shift uncertainty; report repeat or interval distributions at the independent entity or scenario level.
Preserve unfavorable repeats, unsupported slices, and shift failures; do not treat correlated windows or simulator descendants as independent replicates.
Recompute the bound metrics across fixed onset-window and horizon strata without adding fits.
validation_checks: Verify manifest completeness, zero identifier overlap, identical controls, numeric resource logs, and no operational extrapolation.
Audit split independence and preprocessing isolation before interpreting any selected metric; no label, future, test, or entity-linked information may cross the training boundary.

Verify C-NEML-F01-D1-PRED -> M-NEML-F01-D1-MAE, C-NEML-F01-D1-UQ -> M-NEML-F01-D1-ECE, and C-NEML-F01-D1-DATA -> M-NEML-F01-D1-N, with each claim bound to all four route precondition IDs and Go, Stop, and Pivot coverage.
Check calibration, OOD behavior, and distribution-shift sensitivity for the uncertainty and transfer hypotheses; preserve the route's metric and resource ceilings.
Offline contract validation is not nuclear-safety validation and does not establish model performance, generalization, causal validity, deployment qualification, or target-domain transfer.
failure_modes: Entity, temporal, trajectory, scenario, or preprocessing leakage can inflate the selected metrics and invalidate all three claims.
Label contamination, shortcut learning, confounding, missing-not-at-random data, or break-size imbalance can change predictive or uncertainty conclusions.
Dataset, prevalence, simulator, or target-domain shift can produce unstable held-out behavior and false transfer.
Overfitting or unstable optimization can make candidate gains non-reproducible under the fixed controls and fit ceiling.
Miscalibration or OOD overconfidence can make uncertainty appear acceptable while failing under shift.
Failed physics constraints, unit mismatch, or non-conservative learned behavior can invalidate the hybrid claim and require specialist review.
safety_boundaries: Use only public or open simulated data; method coaching does not access plant data, run a simulator, train or run a model, download weights, allocate compute, deploy services, or issue an operational decision.
Preserve deterministic protections, interlocks, conservative rules, defense in depth, shutdown authority, and human or operator authority; a learned component must not silently replace them.
No operational, protection, licensing, qualification, or nuclear-safety credit is permitted; regulatory and licensing decisions remain outside method coaching.
Require qualified data, ML, nuclear-domain, security, privacy, and safety review before consequential use; target-domain transfer remains a hypothesis.
Offline contract validation is not nuclear-safety validation.
